_comment: W3 development grid (SPEC_D1 §9.2 W3), O7 allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B on the W1 corpus at 20M olmo3 tokens (--max-tokens 20570743 = band-2 end; floor to 10,044 windows), --snapshot-bands 1, --poles S ∪ S_gate. Same job module and steps as the AWS lane (infra/aws_pg/steps/neurons_w3_grid_b.json) with every S3 path rewritten to results/mdl/neurons/... (the box user reads only results/mdl/*). Each checkpoint (14.6 GB) is downloaded in-run into HF_HUB_CACHE and deleted after its harvest; weights_mode download with no weights_hf_repo skips lifecycle's own download and requires inet_down>=800. Expected about 15.1 h per job (8 x 1.88 h + boot); max_billed_h 21 is 1.4x. pg_git_sha names 17057bd0, which holds the shipped code; the commit that adds this manifest changes no code. Job b = T_7..T_14, each with --positions <job a's T_15 poles/positions.npz on S3>; it must not start before that file exists at s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/mdl/neurons/w3/grid/1/out/t15_step1413814/poles/positions.npz (copy it there from job a's output, wherever job a ran). Its steps hold no local path. The mendeleev budget.json ceiling ($30) is below the user's vast credit; the coordinator raises it to the credit before any W3 rental.
